title: Dana proposes a record
goal: Dana finds a fact that every member of the project needs. She asks the agent to propose it, and she confirms the text before anything is written.

steps.title: Dana asks the agent
before: Dana says in plain words what she wants. The agent calls the tool `agentcore_propose` with a text.

frame.title: pi: ~/example-project
frame.source: round 1 of the live proof: the screen of the Pi pane during a propose; the chat line is an example

lines.text: The integration tests failed until I ran npm run db:reset. Please propose this to the project memory.

lines.name: agentcore_propose
lines.args: text="In example-project, run `npm run db:reset` before the integration tests. The tests expect a...

after: The tool block shows the name of the tool and its input on one line. Pi shows at most 100 characters of the input and ends a longer input with `...`. The working line says that the tool waits.
The agent chooses the words of the text. Dana reads the whole text in the next step.

steps.title: The confirmation dialog
before: Pi stops and shows a dialog. Its first line is the target namespace. Its second line is the exact text of the record.

frame.title: pi: ~/example-project
frame.source: round 1 of the live proof: the confirm dialog in the Pi pane

lines.title: /project/example-project/proposals/dana/
lines.text: In example-project, run `npm run db:reset` before the integration tests. The tests expect an empty database.

after: Dana reads both lines. She presses Enter on Yes. Only then does the core write the record.

steps.title: The record id
before: The core writes one record with `BatchCreateMemoryRecords`. It adds the metadata `actorId`, `projectId`, `agent`, `harness`, `host`, `session` and `proposedAt`.

frame.title: pi: ~/example-project
frame.source: round 1 of the live proof: the tool result of the session; the layout of a finished block comes from the Pi 1.2.0 code; the chat line is an example

lines.args: text="In example-project, run `npm run db:reset` before the integration tests. The tests expect a...

lines.text: Proposed. The record id is mem-EXAMPLE4-0000-4000-8000-0000example4. A maintainer of example-project reviews it before the other members see it.

after: The tool answers with the record id and the namespace.

steps.title: If Dana says No
before: Dana can also choose No or press Escape.

after: Nothing is written. A Pi session without a dialog, for example `pi -p`, also answers No.

steps.title: Where the record is now
before: Dana's policy allows a read of her own proposals namespace.
The store answers a list from an index that lags one to five minutes behind a write. Dana waits a few minutes. Then she lists the namespace with her key.

frame.title: dana@laptop: ~/example-project
frame.source: the AWS CLI help of `list-memory-records`, and the metadata keys of the proposal in the live proof (round 1); the live proof listed the proposal through the core only

lines.text: "text": "In example-project, run `npm run db:reset` before the integration tests. The tests expect an empty database."

after: The record is in `/project/example-project/proposals/dana/`. Dana and the maintainers of the project can read it. Alice is the maintainer.
`proposedAt` is earlier than `createdAt`. The core sets `proposedAt` before the dialog, and the store sets `createdAt` at the write.

steps.title: Where the record is not
before: Chen is a member of the same project. He searches Dana's proposals namespace with his own key.

frame.title: chen@laptop: ~
frame.source: round 1 of the live proof: a read of the test person in the proposals namespace of another person

lines.text: aws bedrock-agentcore retrieve-memory-records --memory-id mem-EXAMPLE --namespace /project/example-project/proposals/dana/ --search-criteria searchQuery=tests --profile pi-memory-person-chen

aws: [ERROR]: An error occurred (AccessDeniedException) when calling the RetrieveMemoryRecords operation: User: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/pi-memory-person-chen is not authorized to perform this operation

after: No other member sees the proposal. Recall never reads a proposals namespace, so no recall shows it, also not a recall of Dana.

learned: The dialog shows the target namespace and the exact text. Nothing is written before Yes.
The tool answers with the record id.
Only Dana and the maintainers of the project can read the proposal.
cannot: Dana's agent cannot write to `/project/example-project/shared/`. IAM denies it.
It cannot write to the proposals namespace of another person.
A model cannot propose without a human confirmation. A session without a dialog answers No.
A proposal is not visible in any recall.
A batch with one allowed and one other namespace is denied as a whole.
